All denominators at positive total degree are positive. The exact degrees 2,4,6 determine radial R1,R2,R3; planar isotropy maps them to projection even moments and yields the two stated rational cumulants. The fourth sign changes at g4=(7d+3)/2. The sixth numerator P_d(g)=C_d-B_d g-A_d g^2 has C_d,A_d,B_d>0, is strictly decreasing and has one positive root; P_d(g4)=-8(2d+1)(3d+1)(4d+3)<0 forces 0<g6<g4. At g4 c6 is explicitly negative. Adding independent isotropic Brownian translational noise gives a Gaussian OU summand with all cumulants >=4 zero. Independently recursed complex Fourier moments with exact rational arithmetic d=1,g=2, obtaining c4=-1/384, c6=13/36864 and matching source formulas; symbolic derivation of full rational expressions was independently cross-checked. Universal statement relies on recurrence and polynomial signs, not samples.
